content: REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION FOR A WEBSITE: 1. PRD. 2. UI/UX Design System & Wireframes. 3. Content Architecture & Sitemap. 4. SEO & Metadata Spec. 5. Performance & Web Vitals Budget (LCP, INP, CLS). 6. Analytics & Event Tracking Plan. 7. Security Policy (CSP, HTTPS). 8. Privacy Policy & Cookie Consent. 9. Disaster Recovery & Hosting Fallback. 10. Runbooks & Deployment Spec. 11. Audit Reports. 12. Dependency Analysis. 13. Style Guide.
